title: The Honest trader at the market
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：honest　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 honest 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the painter wrote of ① an honest trader at the market in the catalogue, and everybody in the studio said at once that it was ② more honest than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the painter, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the honest ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most honest trader at the market anybody in the studio had ever seen, or so the catalogue for May 1983 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too honest to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the honest ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an honest answer about the money, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as honest as the answer about the money they had once had in the old studio. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was honest or not, and he said so.

By 1996 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was ⑦ something honest, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next studio called the whole plan ⑧ quite honest; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the catalogue kept the names of the honest ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1999, year after year, she wrote of another honest trader at the market in the same catalogue, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more honest than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most honest answer about the money in the whole studio, she said in 2001, was the one she could never quite name; the honest ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 诚实（前置定语 an honest trader at the market：1989 年画师在展品目录里记下的那件诚实的生意人）
B. adj. 诚实／坦诚（比较级 more honest than：文中两处，一处比集市上诚实的生意人，一处比预想）
C. adj. 诚实／坦诚（最高级 the most honest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 诚实（表语 too honest to do：母亲觉得它太诚实，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 坦诚（前置定语 an honest answer about the money：叔叔把整件事称作一桩坦诚的回答）
F. adj. 坦诚（同级比较 as honest as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩关于钱款的坦诚回答相比）
G. adj. 坦诚（后置定语 something honest：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 坦诚（受程度副词修饰 quite honest：那位观者的评价）

items.q: an honest trader at the market
the most honest trader at the market anybody
an honest answer about the money
The most honest answer about the money in

answers.why: honest 意为“诚实”，1989 年画师在展品目录里记下的是“一件诚实的生意人”，此处作前置定语 an honest trader at the market。
honest 意为“诚实”，此处用比较级 more honest than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
honest 意为“诚实”，展品目录上 五月 那行字说它是画室里最诚实的一件，故用最高级 the most honest trader at the market。
honest 意为“诚实”，母亲认为这件东西“太诚实了，谁也用不上”，too honest to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
honest 意为“坦诚”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩坦诚的回答”，此处作前置定语 an honest answer about the money。
honest 意为“坦诚”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩关于钱款的坦诚回答一样坦诚”，同级比较用 as honest as。
honest 意为“坦诚”，展品目录上那半行字要的是“坦诚的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something honest。
honest 意为“坦诚”，邻画室来的那位观者认为这套计划“相当坦诚”，quite 修饰原级 honest。
honest 意为“坦诚”，1999 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要坦诚”，故用比较级 more honest than。
honest 意为“坦诚”，母亲 2001 年说的是“整个画室里最坦诚的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most honest answer about the money。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年，画师在展品目录里记下了一件诚实的生意人。（an honest trader at the market）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更诚实。（more honest than …）
母亲觉得它太诚实，谁也用不上。（too honest to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩坦诚的回答。（an honest answer about the money）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩关于钱款的坦诚回答一样坦诚。（as honest as …）
到了 1996 年，展品目录上只剩半行字：要的是一件坦诚的东西。（something honest）
answers: In 1989 the painter wrote of an honest trader at the market in the catalogue.
Everybody said it was more honest than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too honest to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an honest answer about the money.
He said nobody would call it as honest as the answer about the money they had once had.
By 1996 the catalogue asked for nothing but something honest.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 honest 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the painter wrote of an honest trader at the market in the catalogue, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most honest trader at the market in the studio, or so the catalogue says.
My mother thought it too honest to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an honest answer about the money, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next studio called the plan quite honest, and everybody laughed.
The honest ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
